title: デビュー戦の後に・運命のレース

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru, the Umamusume blessed with divine luck, performs well in her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Intending to let the fates decide her next goal, she asks me to draw a fortune slip.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Following the will of the fortune slip, it seems our next race is the Yayoi Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The first hurdle of spring is here! Matikanefukukitaru's battle has begun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Following the will of the fortune slip, it seems our next race is the Spring Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
